title: Ruling Elder Cooke Lewis et al. v. Grace Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Assembly adopted the Judicial Commission's judgment that none of the complaint's three items, nor the complaint as a whole, was sustained because no challenged action violated the BCO; it also urged continued reconciliation.
first_summary: Members of a congregation challenged Grace Presbytery's formation of an administrative commission, its method of appointing the commission, and its refusal to dissolve the pastoral relationship after a 26-16 congregational vote. The General Assembly adopted its Judicial Commission's judgment declining to sustain each item or the complaint as a whole because none of the challenged actions violated the BCO. It also urged all parties to continue efforts toward reconciliation.
